facility_desc: Robotic fulfillment center, 3.8M sf, 2120 Hartford Ave
program: Tax Stabilization Incentive (RI Commerce Corporation) reimbursement to Town of Johnston
notes: Board vote 2021-10-25, unanimous (8-0). Resolution: reimbursement not to exceed lesser of 10% of actual forgone revenue or $1,538,927 (about 2% proposed), subject to incentive agreement and eligibility verification. Paid to the town, not Amazon. Amazon also agreed to fund RI Small Business Assistance Program $2.75M over 5 years (a payment BY Amazon). No clawback info found.

facility_desc: Same project, Town of Johnston 20-year tax stabilization agreement
program: Johnston Town Council tax stabilization agreement (fixed payments: 5.7M in Jan 2024 rising to 9.1M in Jan 2044)
issuer: Providence Business News reporting Johnston Town Council agreement
notes: Payments total 145.6M vs about 155.9M taxes at 28.67/1000 commercial rate, so value about 10M by PBN's estimate assuming level rate and assessed value (my reading of article; not a town figure). Council vote scheduled 2021-09-15; Boston Globe reported approval. Town agreement text not obtained. Community benefits (>12M over 20 yrs) are Amazon payments, not subsidy. Facility opened about Nov 2024.
